customers_say: Customers find the smart lock to be of good quality with reliable face unlock functionality that works quickly. They appreciate its classy design that looks like a simple door handle, user-friendly app interface, and top-notch installation. The lock features multiple access options, and customers consider it secure and worth the investment, though opinions on value are mixed.

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Mightly impressed
reviews.body: Seamless unlocking via face unlock. Fingerprint is smooth and fast too. Battery life is great, been a month and only used some 20% of battery till now. The lock is sturdy and is built to last. All the user biometric data is stored offline as I tried unlocking it without wifi access and it worked perfectly !

reviews.author: Brijesh Mehta
reviews.title: Very good product
reviews.body: It's 2 months we bought this product & it's an amazing one. It functions beautifully & has added a lot of comfort & convenience. It's worth it.

reviews.author: Anant P.
reviews.title: Top Notch product
reviews.body: Fabulous product with all the available features, looks premium, feels premium, top notch installation and customer support

reviews.author: Madhav
reviews.title: Good Device with Scope for Improvement in Video Recording, Face Unlock and Customer Support
reviews.body: The device is good overall, but it would be excellent if it included a video recording feature with at least seven days of recording storage and playback. The face unlock feature also needs improvement, as its performance is not very satisfactory. Most importantly, I would strongly urge UC to provide a toll-free customer care number to ensure quick resolution of customer issues. Reliable and easily accessible customer support would significantly improve the overall user experience and customer satisfaction.

reviews.author: PARAG SACHANIA
reviews.title: Sleek and utilitarian
reviews.body: Excellent Smart Lock with Premium Looks and Features I recently purchased the Native Lock Ultra by Urban Company from Amazon, and so far, I am very impressed with the product. The lock has a sleek, premium-looking design and blends really well with the door. What I particularly like is the variety of access options available — fingerprint, face recognition and RFID, in addition to the other conventional options.
